before.test/protocol_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule ProtocolTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "both supported v1 message forms" do
    {:ok, pid} = StatusServer.start_link(4)
    assert GenServer.call(pid, :snapshot) == {:ready, 4}
    assert GenServer.call(pid, {:snapshot, :v1}) == {:ready, 4}
  end
end
